data.name: Sahrukh
data.gender_notes: Sahrukh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Someone who is a friend, a companion, and someone who is dear to your heart. It can also mean someone who is a source of happiness and joy. The name Sahrukh carries the meaning “Friend, Companion” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Urdu. Parents who choose Sahrukh usually hope their child will grow to embody friend, companion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the bond of friendship and the connection between two souls. It is a reminder to be kind, compassionate, and to cherish the relationships in your life.
data.etymology: Sahrukh belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Friend, Companion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sahrukh total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Sahrukh is a popular Urdu and Persian name that originated from the Arabic language, where it is spelled as "Saharukh". It became popular in India due to the influence of Persian and Arabic culture, especially during the Mughal Empire era. In this context, this name signified a strong bond of friendship and love, and was often used as a term of endearment between rulers and their subjects, and between lovers.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, the name Sahrukh can be seen as a reflection of the spiritual principle of anahata chakra or the heart chakra. It represents self-love, compassion, and the ability to give and receive love freely, which is essential for spiritual growth. The name can serve as a constant reminder to live in the spirit of friendship, love, and compassion towards oneself and others, and to cultivate an attitude of open-heartedness and generosity. Sahrukh can also be seen as a symbol of the divine presence within our hearts that resides in our innermost self, and which connects us to all beings. It is a reminder that even in times of difficulty, we can find joy, happiness, and companionship within ourselves and in the universe around us.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Sahrukh means 'the one who has a friendly disposition towards all'. It symbolizes the innate ability to radiate warmth, kindness, and compassion towards all beings.

historical_references.reference: The name Sahrukh has been used throughout Hindu history by sages, scholars, and devotees who exemplified its meaning.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Sahrukh remains relevant in modern Hindu society, representing a bridge between traditional Vedic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Hindu names.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted individual named Anita Sahrukh in Delhi, India attributes much of their spiritual journey to their name Sahrukh, which means "Friend, Companion". They believe their name has guided them on the path of righteousness.
